tasks.decision: W falls within P’s adopted design boundary A. Apply the adopted rules whose conditions hold. B is outside this declaration. Profile availability alone does not establish Product adoption or authorize actor activation.
tasks.justification: The durable Product-owned frame basis, work-scoped activation and individual evaluations are separate relations. Partial design adoption narrows its declared scope; it does not waive independently applicable common constraints. Unresolved boundary membership must remain unresolved.

representation.statement: Bounded contract: determine each work obligation from its owning rule, Product adoption, governed boundary and triggering facts; separately determine whether an exact actor evaluation has an applicable frame basis and authorized activation.
premises: The selected cut includes Design Module Method and the engagement-baseline profile. P has adopted a named design rule family for A; B lies outside that declaration; W changes A.
The case establishes design adoption, but does not itself establish adoption of the available engagement profile or supply a concrete actor activation.
Each evaluation binds an exact predicate, subject, basis, evidence boundary, capability envelope and applicable authority.
applicability: For W, membership in A is established. An adopted design rule applies when its particular trigger holds; changing A alone does not establish every material-change, schema, derivation or implementation trigger.
For B, this particular adoption supplies no design obligation. That supported scope exclusion does not remove obligations arising from other applicable owners.
For later work whose relation to A cannot be established, retain unresolved applicability. Do not classify it as outside the adoption or not applicable merely because evidence is missing.
Partial design adoption does not change otherwise applicable common safety, authority, assurance or acceptance constraints.
obligations: Bind the accepted Product-owned Project Reference-Frame Basis: exact method and optional profile basis, admitting authorities, governed scope, frame declarations and evaluation inventory, actor-binding rules, capability envelopes, grants, result and coverage relations, activation triggers and invalidation law. Locator metadata does not itself create this declaration or its authority.

An authorized work instruction carries the actor activation: actor, applicable frame or configuration, exact evaluation, subject, basis, evidence boundary and capability envelope. The durable Product basis remains distinct from this temporary execution binding.

Under an adopted baseline, use a sufficient direct Worker frame where adequate; coordination is conditional on material need, Reviewer assessment on its governing requirement, and specialist evaluations on materiality. Retain material coverage that the activation cannot supply.

For an applicable design-completion claim, preserve the conditional gates: a new or materially changed adopted boundary needs accepted Ontology evidence; schema or typed-carrier change needs derived and reconciled IACS; derivation from an existing realization needs published reference-to-target and Ontology-derived three-view assets; active implementation needs a published module-derived unit test lane.
exceptions: Partial adoption is permitted with its boundary and rule family named. It cannot support a design-method completion claim that omits the evidence needed to audit, refactor or reconstruct the realized boundary.
The baseline is optional; Product authority may admit another frame configuration. Available frames do not require a fixed actor hierarchy, permanent actor assignments or a separate runtime engine.
A frame label or actor identity supplies no additional semantic, operation, review, acceptance or disposition grant.
result_mapping: W: adopted-boundary applicability is established; satisfaction of particular work obligations still depends on their conditions and evidence.
B: outside this declared design adoption, without a blanket exemption from other applicable constraints.

Later work with unresolved boundary membership: applicability remains undecided; a dependent conjunction is indeterminate absent an independently decisive applicable failure or established basis/scope diagnosis.
Availability, fitness and authorized acceptance remain separate predicates. Evaluations retain their performance, original qualified outcome, evidence, effects and residual coverage.
residuals: A concrete activation requires the exact accepted Product frame basis, applicable grants and authorized work packet; the scenario does not supply their identities.
The particular adopted rule family and W’s additional triggering facts determine the remaining work obligations.

Profile availability, Product adoption, and execution-scoped activation are
three distinct relations.

The Product definition records the
durable shared basis. A ticket or other authorized work instruction carries the
activation packet.
-> Worker and applicable specialist evaluations; Reviewer only where required

Partial adoption is allowed, but the adopted boundary and adopted rule family
should be named explicitly.

It must not be used to claim design-method completion while skipping the evidence
needed to audit, refactor, or reconstruct the realized boundary.

Required
safety, authority and acceptance conditions remain applicable to every selected
strategy.

Otherwise any unresolved applicability, missing evaluation, undecidable
   predicate or undecided material join yields `indeterminate`.

unknowns: The concrete Product-adopted frame declaration and activation grants are unspecified.
The later work item’s boundary membership is explicitly unresolved; no exclusion or waiver follows.

tasks.decision: Declare a handoff contract that preserves separate availability, fitness and authorized-acceptance results, and a conjunction over a fixed required set and its material joins. This does not assert that X satisfies the contract.
tasks.justification: Required coverage comes from the declared contract, not the returns received. Missing assessments remain absent slots. For an interpretable conjunction, an authenticated applicable counterexample defeats the conjunction even when another assessment is missing.

representation.statement: Proposed composite H(X,B) requires availability of X, satisfaction of its declared criteria, and acceptance of X by the mandate-bound owner, together with every additional required predicate and material join declared for this handoff.
premises: Bind X and B exactly. Bind the criteria, acceptance mandate and owner, required assessment inventory, producer authentication and predicate mappings.
Availability, fitness and authorized acceptance are distinct predicates. A result that a disposition was lawfully made is also distinct from a result that X was accepted.
Fix the required coverage independently of which evaluators return.
applicability: Authenticate every contribution against its producer, exact subject, basis and required plan membership before using it to discharge a slot.

A return about another subject or an inapplicable basis cannot discharge the intended slot. Preserve any valid finding on its original coordinates; do not automatically diagnose the entire composite basis as invalid.
A stale return needs supported current applicability or preservation before reuse. Otherwise current coverage remains unfilled.
A supported out-of-frame diagnosis does not silently remove the predicate from the wider obligation.
obligations: Each handoff result preserves predicate, exact subject and basis, verdict, performance, original domain outcome and cause, evidence and citations, unresolved obligations and material effect observations. Sufficient resolvable references may carry these fields.

Verdicts are satisfied, falsified, indeterminate, out_of_frame or invalid_basis. Performance is performed, not_performed or unconfirmed; applying the aggregate rule establishes aggregate performance without changing component performance.

A required assessment known not to have occurred remains missing coverage with performance not_performed. An absent return retains whatever performance is known; absence or dispatch alone does not establish non-performance or performance. Do not fabricate a child evaluation result.

Domain refinements preserve the qualified original outcome and provide a total, reason-sensitive mapping. A missing required reason leaves the claimed predicate indeterminate and the contribution inadmissible as deciding support.

Declare effect boundaries and normalize current observations for every material possibly affected part, including parts associated with absent slots and unintended effects. Possible effects with unobserved completion remain unknown; observed completed parts remain evidence.
exceptions: A record with not_performed or unconfirmed performance cannot be satisfied. Separately admissible counterevidence can nevertheless establish falsified, and independent basis or scope evidence can establish the corresponding diagnosis without inventing execution.
candidate_ready may satisfy availability while fitness is falsified or unassessed. A lawful rejection may satisfy a disposition-made predicate without establishing fitness or acceptance.
Effect uncertainty blocks satisfaction when the bound predicate requires a known effect state. An unrelated uncertain effect does not automatically defeat another predicate.

Alternative operators evaluate different predicates. Their truth and falsity conditions must be declared, disjoint and exhaustive on their fully decided admitted domain; they cannot erase failed leaves or be presented as this conjunction.
result_mapping: If the composite subject or governing basis itself cannot be interpreted, return invalid_basis while exposing independently valid component failures.
For an interpretable composite: any authenticated, applicable falsification of a required predicate or material join makes H falsified, retaining missing or undecidable coverage alongside it.
Without such falsification: an invalid required basis yields invalid_basis; otherwise a required out-of-frame judgment yields out_of_frame.
Otherwise unresolved applicability, missing evaluations, undecidable predicates or undecided material joins yield indeterminate.
H is satisfied only when every applicable required obligation and material join is authentically satisfied and coverage itself is established. An empty return list proves no such coverage.
The composite effect state is unknown if any normalized material part remains unknown. Unknown completion is never silently converted to completed or not_requested.
residuals: The consumer must declare the exact criteria, required assessments, joins, authentication and current-applicability conditions, and qualified domain-result mappings.
The consumer must distinguish admission conditions from material joins. A failed required join cannot be relabeled as a missing admission basis to hide counterevidence.
The consumer must declare the effect boundary and which effect states matter to H. No concrete verdict for X is supplied by this contract.

If any material remainder has unknown completion, the state is `unknown`,
retaining the completed parts as evidence.

First authenticate each contribution against its producer, subject, basis and
required plan membership.

Any authenticated, applicable falsification of a required predicate or material join makes

`satisfied` requires every applicable obligation and material join to be

The original
record keeps its original subject; an applicability relation permits its use

unknowns: The consumer’s concrete assessment inventory, criteria, joins, result refinements and effect dependencies are not supplied.
No actual availability, fitness or authorized-acceptance result for X/B is stipulated.

tasks.decision: Reuse A through its established applicability relation. Select B for current reassessment. Do not exclude or reuse C on the strength of the incomplete dependency view. G cannot be skipped. Refuse the manager’s 99% correctness inference. Followups: P satisfied; F falsified with missing coverage retained; U indeterminate.
tasks.justification: A has the stipulated dependency and preservation support. B executes the changed library; C’s absent path supplies no supported non-influence argument. Shared expected-output derivation and observations defeat the offered independence justification. Even a justified 0.01 joint miss rate would make 0.99 a conditional detection probability, not a probability that the Product is correct.

representation.statement: Evaluate the bounded completion claim on S1/B1 as satisfaction of every fixed required assurance obligation and material join, with established coverage. Merely dispatching assessments or completing an assessment procedure is a different predicate.
premises: A, B and C passed historically on S0/B0. A’s material assertion, execution and reliance dependencies are covered, unaffected and supported by an applicable preservation relation to S1/B1.
B executes L. C’s material dependency coverage is incomplete despite the absence of a displayed path from L.
G applies independently of change-based selection. The two agreeing suites share an implementation-derived expected-output generator and old observations.
applicability: A: retain its historical result for current reliance through the established applicability relation. Keep S0/B0 as the original record’s coordinates; no new execution need be invented or required merely because the subject changed.

B: its dependency on changed L makes current reliance affected. The old pass alone does not discharge the current obligation; obtain current reassessment or a separately supported preservation argument.

C: incomplete coverage prevents an unaffectedness conclusion. Acquire supported dependency coverage and preservation, or current assessment evidence; until then its required assurance remains unresolved.
obligations: G remains required and cannot be removed by change-based selection.
Retain known failures, unresolved coverage and their citations alongside applicable retained and newly acquired evidence.

Any numerical assurance claim needs a declared population or uncertainty model, priors, likelihoods, shared causes and calibration limits. Replacing conditional joint-miss factors by 0.1 and 0.1 requires the relevant conditional independence.
exceptions: Different model families do not establish statistical independence. Agreement can reflect shared error; repeated observations are not new independent evidence.
Implementation-derived assertions may support justified regression or local properties. Repeating the implementation’s decision does not independently justify the upstream requirement.
Full-suite rerunning is not universally required, and full-suite execution would not itself prove complete coverage.
result_mapping: P: satisfied. B and C have valid current passing evidence, G passes, A’s applicability is established, and every fixed required obligation and material join has valid support. These stipulated facts establish the bounded assurance-completion predicate without demanding additional hypothetical evidence.

F: falsified. B’s admissible counterexample defeats a required predicate. C’s absent current return remains an explicit uncovered slot with unconfirmed performance unless other performance evidence exists; it does not downgrade the known failure to mere indeterminacy.

U: indeterminate. B and G pass and no counterexample is present, but C has only a dispatch receipt. That receipt supplies neither a returned judgment nor evidence that the selected evaluation was performed.

The manager’s numerical conclusion is unsupported. Even under justified independence, 1 - 0.1 × 0.1 concerns at least one detection conditional on a violation and the stated model; it is not posterior whole-Product correctness.
residuals: For initial C reuse, acquire material dependency/preservation support or reassess C on the current subject and basis.
For F, preserve the counterexample until supported repair, reassessment or authorized change of obligation disposes it; missing required assessments remain visible.
For U, acquire C’s authenticated current result and deciding evidence. A dispatch receipt cannot close the slot.
P establishes the specified assurance conjunction. None of these branches grants Product acceptance or release authority.

sources.quote:

cannot invalidate the reused claim. An absent edge proves no non-influence.

New obligations and uncovered cases create assessment work even when no existing
check covers them; mandatory gates remain applicable.

The original

for the new claim.

Different actors, families or
codebases do not establish statistical independence.

One minus the joint miss probability is the
chance of at least one detection under those conditions, not the probability
that the whole product is correct.
Dispatch or admission alone does not establish performance.

Any authenticated, applicable falsification of a required predicate or material join makes

`satisfied` requires every applicable obligation and material join to be

unknowns: Initially, C’s safe reuse is unestablished; in U its current required assessment is absent.
The suites’ actual joint miss probability and posterior Product-correctness probability are not established.
P has no remaining assurance gap under the stipulated bounded facts. Product acceptance and release are separate decisions not supplied by the scenario.

tasks.decision: The present design-method completion declaration is falsified: two applicable prerequisites are known to be unmet. P satisfies the bounded gate. U leaves adoption applicability and the dependent completion claim indeterminate.
tasks.justification: For this adopted, materially changed, reference-derived boundary with active implementation, the owner text requires both the reference-to-target derivation asset and a module-derived unit test lane. The accepted Ontology, reconciled IACS and published three-view assets satisfy their stipulated conditions; they do not substitute for the missing prerequisites. Silence in a returned representation cannot defeat these explicit obligations.

representation.statement: Evaluate design-method completion for W’s changed boundary on the current basis against the applicable adoption and design gates, preserving the separate Product-acceptance and release questions.
premises: In the present case, the adopted boundary covers A and its active implementation. W materially changes A’s typed schema and derives from an existing realization.

The accepted Ontology is complete for the material change, including admitted atom domains and projection traceability. IACS is derived and reconciled, and Ontology-derived domain, sequence and state assets are published.
The reference-to-target derivation asset is unpublished. Only helper-level tests exist, with no published module-derived unit test lane.
All other applicable criteria for this bounded gate have adequate current evidence.
applicability: The present adopted-boundary, material-change, schema, reference-derivation and active-implementation conditions are established; the corresponding gates apply.
In U, the old adoption boundary’s relation to the changed service is unestablished. Retain that uncertainty instead of assuming either continuing coverage or exemption.
obligations: Reference-derived design completion requires the published reference-to-target derivation evidence as well as the Ontology-derived three-view asset.
Active implementation requires a published module-derived unit test lane justified against accepted module ownership and obligations.
A module test lane must supply module proof; helper structure alone does not establish the required derivation.
exceptions: Helper-level tests are permitted, but cannot become the canonical proof surface for the module boundary.
Partial adoption can narrow scope, but cannot justify a completion claim that skips required audit and reconstruction evidence.
No additional Ontology, IACS or three-view defect is inferred: those facts are supplied as adequate.
result_mapping: Present: falsified on the bounded completion predicate; the changed boundary is not closure-ready. The two known missing required publications are decisive, rather than merely unknown evidence.

P: satisfied on the bounded design gate. Both missing assets are published on the current basis, the unit lane is justified, their criteria are established, and all other applicable criteria already have adequate current evidence.

U: indeterminate applicability and dependent completion. The known asset and test facts remain recorded, but their applicability to the current adopted-boundary claim cannot be resolved without the missing boundary relation or authority resolution. Uncertainty alone does not establish invalid_basis or out_of_frame.
Neither the present failure, P’s bounded satisfaction nor U’s uncertainty constitutes Product acceptance or release authorization.
residuals: Present: the derivation asset and justified module-derived unit test lane must become established on the applicable current basis before this gate can be satisfied.
U: establish the lawful relation between the old adoption boundary and the changed service, or obtain the Product-owned scope resolution; do not manufacture it from representation silence.
The returned representation is not established as exhaustive. Exact owning specification text supplies the deciding obligations.

sources.quote:
When the new or materially changed boundary is derived from an existing
realization, the project must also publish the reference-to-target derivation
asset and the Ontology-derived three-view design asset before claiming
design-method completion for the changed boundary.

When the new or materially changed boundary has active implementation, the
project must also publish a module-derived unit test lane before claiming
closure for that change.

If a target realization cannot show that derivation chain, it is not yet
design-method complete under this method.

This does not prohibit helper-level tests.

It does prohibit helper-level tests from becoming the canonical proof surface
for a module boundary.

If a module has code but no module-derived unit test lane, the module is not
closure-ready under this method.

it
does not take ownership of Product-level UAT or acceptance meaning.

Otherwise any unresolved applicability, missing evaluation, undecidable
   predicate or undecided material join yields `indeterminate`.

`satisfied` requires every applicable obligation and material join to be
   authentically satisfied, with coverage itself established.

unknowns: U leaves the adoption-to-current-boundary relation unresolved; no authority resolution is supplied.
P has no remaining gap in the stipulated bounded design gate. Separate Product acceptance and release decisions are not established.
